messages:
mike: Evening — we need a quick overnight inference sweep in eu-west1 (~00:30 UTC). Can someone provision 2 ephemeral H100s (transient) for ~3h? I opened a terraform PR (4321) that wires the reservation. Also need billing code CC-8342 attached to the charge. Any objections or blocking quotas?

anya: Oncall — I can check quota/availability. Which project/reservation name are you planning to use?

mike: project=redwood-inference-staging, reservation=night-sweep-eu. PR: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321. We'll spin up, run the smoke sweep, then teardown. Ephemeral only.

vendor-bot: vendor-portal status: eu-west1 H100 pool currently 2/6 available. Next replenishment ETA ~02:40 UTC. Note: spot/ephemeral prices +15% vs baseline. See https://vendor.example/status/123

anya: Ok looks feasible (2 available). Are you ok with the price bump? also will need a short drain window before teardown — recommend scheduled window 00:20-00:40 UTC so canary traffic shifts.

mike: price bump is fine for this one-off. We'll teardown by 03:45 UTC latest. Schedule the drain window 00:20-00:40.

rebecca: Procurement — I need the GL code and an estimated spend for the ticket. Also attach the terraform snippet or vars so finance can route the invoice correctly.

mike: GL code CC-8342. Estimated spend ~ $1,100 (2 H100 x ~3h incl. overhead). Terraform var snippet below to attach:```hcl
variable "billing_code" {
  type = string
  default = "CC-8342"
}
resource "vendor_compute_reservation" "night_sweep" {
  name       = "night-sweep-eu"
  region     = "eu-west1"
  sku        = "h100"
  count      = 2
  duration_h = 3
  tags = {
    team = "infra",
    teardown = "true",
  }
}
```

rebecca: perfect — I'll attach that to the procurement ticket and approve once PR/merge link is in the ticket. Please include expected PR merge time in the ticket comment.

devex: small suggestion — add an autoscale/destroy_after tag in the TF so we don't leave a slab running if the teardown step fails. Also include a short healthcheck that triggers teardown if the node is idle for >15m.

anya: Will provision once PR is merged and I see the destroy_after tag. Ping me in the PR thread when it's ready.

mike: PR updated with destroy_after=180 (mins) and healthcheck. Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4321#issuecomment-99. Merging after a quick LGTM from anya.

anya: LGTM. I'll merge at 23:55 UTC and start the reservation sequence.

mike: awesome — thanks :thumbsup:

rebecca: I put a placeholder approval in procurement board, tagged invoice team.

vendor-bot: Reminder: ephemeral reservation created at 23:58 UTC, reservation id rsv-7788. Autoscale/destroy_after applied.

mike: Kickoff complete. Running smoke tests now. Will post status when sweep finishes.

anya: Thanks — monitoring for any OOM/eviction alerts. If eviction risk >50% we'll fallback to 1 H100 + cached KV lanes.

mike: Sweep finished clean, teardown in progress. final spend looks ~ $1,030.

rebecca: Closing procurement ticket, final invoice tag CC-8342 attached.

mike: All cleaned up. Good job team :tada:
